title: Closed-fibre admissible-modification presentation of open cohomology
statement:
Let $(A,I)$ be a henselian pair, with $I$ finitely generated, and let $A'=\widehat A$ be its $I$-adic completion [def-weil-pbc-henselian-terminology, def-weil-pbc-adic-completion]. Put $X=\operatorname{Spec}A$, $Z=\operatorname{Spec}(A/I)$, $U=X\setminus V(I)$, and define $X',Z',U'$ by base change to $A'$ [def-weil-affine-spectrum, def-pc-base-change]. Let $F$ be a torsion abelian etale sheaf on $U$ and $F'$ its inverse image on $U'$ [def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaves, def-weil-pbc-inverse-image]. For finitely generated ideals $J$ with $V(J)=V(I)$, form $B_J=\operatorname{Bl}_J(X)$, $Z_J=B_J\times_XZ$, and $j_J:U\hookrightarrow B_J$ [def-nagata-affine-blowup]. Order these blowups by domination, identifying ideals giving the same blowup. Their closed fibres form a cofiltered system. The limit of their small etale topoi, denoted $\mathcal T$, has a conservative family of geometric points (compatible geometric points of the closed fibres). Write $p_J:\mathcal T\to (Z_J)_{\mathrm{et}}$ for the projections and
$$L^q_F=\varinjlim_Jp_J^{-1}\bigl((R^qj_{J*}F)|_{Z_J}\bigr)\quad(q\geq0).$$
Here $R^qj_*$ is the higher direct image on abelian sheaves [def-weil-pbc-direct-image], and the transition maps are the natural pullback/exchange maps. There is a natural first-quadrant cohomological spectral sequence [def-sp-spectral-sequence]
$$E_2^{p,q}=H^p(\mathcal T,L^q_F)\ \Longrightarrow\ H^{p+q}(U_{\mathrm{et}},F).$$
Cohomology on a topos means the right derived functors of global sections, as for [def-weil-pbc-etale-cohomology]. Convergence gives, in total degree $n\geq0$, a filtration with $n+1$ graded pieces $E_\infty^{p,n-p}$. Completion identifies $\mathcal T$ with the corresponding limit topos for $(A',IA')$, by the identifications of the closed fibres of corresponding admissible blowups; the blowups extended from $A$ are cofinal among those for $A'$. Under this identification the exchange maps induce a morphism $L^q_F\to L^q_{F'}$ and a morphism of the displayed spectral sequences. On their abutments it is the canonical pullback $H^n(U,F)\to H^n(U',F')$, including the specified filtrations. No isomorphism of the coefficient sheaves $L^q$ or of the abutments is asserted.

reviewed.note: mechanical checks by tools/merge_delivery.py; mathematics reviewed in full by NT-cc-Q49-7ae04b8c3 (reviewer sub-agent of L); spot-checked: This is a Q112 re-admission: the repair note and coord/changes/20261024-Q112 were read in side-live because the snapshot does not contain them. It is not a 2026-10-21 re-split order. I read ILO XX 4.4, printed pp.373-374: admissible blowups with V(J)=V(I) and at most one X-morphism between them; (**) via proper base change; (**)lim; the same topos for X'; the final Note. The item statement is unchanged and matches the source. There are no SGA citations. I checked all 7 steps against the full statements of the cited nodes: hypotheses (J finitely generated, proper and qcqs transitions, j_J qcqs, torsion with all primes, lower bound 0, completed pair complete hence henselian), exactness, constant connected colimit, and thm-sp-truncation-e2 parts 1-6. Three repairable faults, corrected in fixes/dag/nodes/sec-deligne-laumon-a1/. (1) C1, Step 1: the uniqueness of the X-morphism B_K->B_J, needed for a diagram indexed by the preorder, had no argument or citation. Added the argument (both maps are the identity on the scheme-theoretically dense U, B_J/X is separated) and cited the existing lemma-nagata-ext-scheme-theoretically-dominant-separated, added to proof_deps and tool_uses. (2) C4, Step 7: lem-pc-natural-bounded-below-truncation-couples only chooses some couples Z_M; it does not say they are Step 6's truncation couple. Replaced by the existing lem-pc-raw-truncation-couple-naturality, which gives maps of the def-sp-truncation-couple couples commuting with alpha, f, g, the abutment maps c_n and the E2 identifications; tool_uses updated. (3) E2 wording in lem-per-qcqs-etale-topos-inverse-limit: 'a set of such points is conservative' can be read as 'every set' (false for the empty set), changed to 'there is a set of such points which is conservative'. New nodes are true, statement-only and not duplicates. The topos limit node follows Stacks 09YL, 0A35, 00YQ and Deligne; the points of the 2-limit are compatible geometric points. The derived continuity node follows 09YP and 0EXZ plus the spectral sequence for a uniform lower bound, stated in D(Ab). The proper henselian restriction node follows 0DDD, 0DDE (thm-weil-pbc-bounded-below) and Gabber 09ZI; edge cases I=0 and A=0 hold, and no proper-over-pair derived node exists in the DAG. None restates the item. Batch-5 check: lem-trf-geometric-inverse-image-exact is general exactness of geometric inverse image, and its 132-node closure has no trace-formula or Poincare content beyond two trf definitions. def-trf-geometric-morphism is a general definition with a 4-node closure. Both are outside the assumed statements, so both are accepted. The other declared generic tool uses are accepted. Small cases checked: I=0 or nilpotent, identity completion, a one-object index, n=0, F=0.; 2 file(s) fixed by the reviewer
